description: Append-only owner-observability receipt for one meaningful worker/pipeline event. Workers create unique files under dev-feed/events/ rather than mutating a shared log.
rules: Use a unique file name so parallel workers do not contend on one ledger.
Never rewrite an old event to make history cleaner; append a correction/superseding event.
A merged artifact is not owner-visible unless the canonical destination can be named and opened.
Receipt links and verification evidence should be references, not prose claims.
Do not create an owner-visible event merely because a worker says done.
